proposed_from.topic: Revive parent stat_dp_cate_uniform_design_nuisance_privacy_frontier by proving a log-free target-fiber private T-estimation theorem on the unchanged exact-uniform Hölder pointwise-CATE class. Construct one finite pure-DP estimator from Bernoulli reduction, coherent composite threshold tests, finite wavelet profiles, and scalar-shell exponential selection, and establish R_DP equivalent to max{R_NP,r_G,r_F} without assuming a formula for R_NP, using the separate nonprivate converse, stabilizing an unspecified minimax estimator, or retaining a nuisance-net logarithm. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Independent Bernoullization of bounded outcomes exactly preserves the propensity, arm means, CATE, and both full-class nonprivate and pure-DP minimax risks. Nonprivate minimax risk controls each composite threshold error, while an integrated absolute-risk identity gives a coherent nested family; summing the two candidates per scalar distance shell removes output-cardinality logarithms for stable scores. A finite d=1 randomized-treatment estimator attains max(n^-1/3,(n epsilon)^-1/2) without logs. On the parent’s coupled-nuisance component, singleton mixtures coincide but exact two-record TV equals 4ab and a bounded pair statistic has mean ±4ab, yielding log-free private pair testing. No counterexample forcing a log or third privacy radius was found. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: At the same sample size, construct full-class stable composite scores whose distance-weighted shell errors sum independently of nuisance-sieve size, proving nuisance-entropy cancellation and that Hamming stabilization adds only r_G and r_F for arbitrary least-favorable priors. EARLY KILL TEST: On a finite d=1 two-resolution wavelet family with alpha=beta=1/8 and gamma=1 containing both constant-mixture and shared-sign witnesses, compute nonprivate and private finite programs at the same n, verify every neighboring quantized dataset, and grow the nuisance-sign dimension; a persistent entropy penalty or reliance on the excluded nonprivate formula kills the route. proposed_from.novelty_justification: The field-level novelty is a pure-private upper test on a legal causal family for which one-record nuisance mixtures coincide. The mechanism uses a bounded occupancy-normalized pair score with a common orientation over \(2^k\) profiles and obtains an error exponent independent of nuisance-catalogue size. Asi et al. and Bun et al. are treated as informed-by generic cover comparators, not as results globally tightened here. Schröder et al.'s approximate-private Gaussian CATE releases address a distinct privacy model and estimator architecture. The unresolved full-class projection certificate remains visible as an open question.

seed_details.title: Log-free pure-private pointwise-CATE frontier
seed_details.anchor_location: Kennedy et al., Theorems 1--2 and Section 5; Asi et al., Section 4, Theorem 13, Lemma 15, and Proposition 16.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace finite-cover union control in the private T-mechanism by coherent composite CATE fibers and distance-weighted scalar shells.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for pure-private Hölder pointwise CATE, composite target fibers, and log-free private T-estimation found private CATE algorithms and general logarithmic mechanisms, but no same-class frontier.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from the universal T-mechanism after inserting the Kennedy et al. minimax rate.
seed_details.rebuttal: The published mechanism retains a cover logarithm, and the destination benchmark is the exact-uniform full-class minimax risk kept symbolic rather than Kennedy et al.'s broader-design formula.
seed_details.burned_reason: Angle 0 exhausted one-record affine separation because exact same-class convex-hull identity obstructs it; angle 1 reached only a sparse-occupancy signed-family pair test.

seed_details.title: Nuisance-entropy cancellation for ordered private fibers
seed_details.anchor_location: Section 4, especially Theorem 13, Lemma 15, and the proof of Proposition 16.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the maximum over all cover points by a distance-weighted sum over at most two scalar target candidates per shell while profiling nuisance mixtures inside each fiber.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches combining private composite testing, T-estimators, ordered parameter fibers, and entropy cancellation located Birgé's nonprivate construction and generic private selection with \(\log m\), but no nuisance-multiplicity-free theorem.
seed_details.red_team: Generic private hypothesis selection lower bounds force \(\log m\).
seed_details.rebuttal: Those bounds treat unordered candidate laws; the proposed estimator outputs one scalar per target shell and allows arbitrary nuisance profiling inside a shell, so the relevant multiplicity is not the nuisance-cover cardinality.

seed_details.title: Exact Bernoulli experiment equivalence under pure privacy
seed_details.anchor_location: Section 1 model and Theorems 1--2, where bounded outcomes enter through conditional means and binary laws appear as lower-bound submodels.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Upgrade the usual binary-subclass lower-bound reduction to a two-sided recordwise Markov-kernel comparison of privacy-constrained decision rules.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for Bernoullization, bounded-mean experiment comparison, CATE minimax equality, and differential privacy found coupling lower bounds but no exact equality for both private and nonprivate risks.
seed_details.red_team: The equality is a routine randomized-rounding observation.
seed_details.rebuttal: The nonprivate direction needs conditional Jensen for randomized preprocessing, and the private direction needs an all-input replacement-adjacency argument; the result is useful but is retained as a supporting theorem rather than the headline.

seed_details.title: Dimension-free private pair test for singleton-cancelled CATE fibers
seed_details.anchor_location: Canonne et al., Theorem 1.2 and Section 2; Acharya et al., Theorem 1 and Section 2.1.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the additive clamped one-record likelihood increment by a bounded two-record contrast because prior-averaged singleton laws coincide.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for private composite U-statistic tests, shared-prior mixtures, and dimension-free pair testing found simple private tests and coupling converses, but no upper theorem for this nuisance geometry.
seed_details.red_team: A clamped likelihood ratio on the product experiment already solves the pair problem.
seed_details.rebuttal: The original i.i.d. data do not arrive as public independent pairs sharing a nuisance sign, and a valid full-class score must handle random occupancy and composite priors without dimension-dependent selection.

seed_details.title: Non-Gaussian limit law for scalar-shell private CATE
seed_details.anchor_location: Main scalar optimality theorem and the conclusion on geometrically decaying staircase noise.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Combine local-polynomial sampling fluctuation with the discrete scalar-shell selection law at a privacy-to-sampling transition.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for limit laws of private nonparametric point estimators and private CATE found rate results and algorithmic releases, not a transition distribution for a shell-selected estimator.
seed_details.red_team: A limit law is impossible to specify before the full-class score construction exists.
seed_details.rebuttal: The direction is credible on the randomized-treatment submodel, but it is downstream of the selected score certificate and therefore is not the first-version kernel.

seed_details.title: Pure-private efficiency bound for pointwise CATE
seed_details.anchor_location: Kennedy, Theorems 1--3; Asi, Duchi, and Talwar, Sections 1--3.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Attempt to replace the parametric Hessian certificate with a local Hölder tangent modulus for evaluation at \(x_0\).
seed_details.destination_search: The search obstruction is structural: point evaluation over a Hölder ball is nonregular, so the classical root-\(n\) semiparametric efficiency bound is not the correct focal object without changing the target to a smoothed CATE functional.
seed_details.red_team: The efficiency bound is infinite because pointwise CATE is not pathwise differentiable in the nonparametric model.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds on the unchanged target; changing to a smoothed target would abandon the brief.

seed_details.title: Privacy-regret frontier for local treatment choice
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction, meta-algorithm, and Theorem 6 on private CATE learners.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace pointwise absolute error by welfare regret of a policy class and translate target-fiber tests into treatment decisions near the zero-CATE margin.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for differentially private policy learning and CATE-based treatment rules locate private learners, but the unchanged single-point target supplies no policy distribution or margin class.
seed_details.red_team: This is not the same estimand: policy regret integrates treatment decisions over covariates rather than estimating \(\tau(x_0)\).
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection is decisive for this brief, although the direction is credible after adding a policy class and margin model.

seed_details.title: Permutation-inverted private confidence set for pointwise CATE
seed_details.anchor_location: Section 1 model and Section 5 discussion of pointwise CATE estimation.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Attempt to generate a valid symmetry orbit after Bernoullization and invert privatized target-fiber tests.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for conformal or permutation pointwise CATE under observational assignment found no exact orbit compatible with conditional exchangeability and continuous \(X\) at a fixed \(x_0\).
seed_details.red_team: Conditional exchangeability is not an observable finite-sample permutation symmetry, and repeated observations at \(x_0\) have probability zero.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds without changing to a randomized design or approximate local exchangeability, so the seed is dropped.

seed_details.title: Entropy cancellation or a third private radius
seed_details.anchor_location: Bun et al., main finite-hypothesis sample-complexity theorem; Asi et al., Proposition 16.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Embed a growing nuisance-sign family at a fixed scalar separation and test whether its private minimax program exhibits a persistent cover-entropy penalty.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for lower bounds with many nuisance profiles and a one-dimensional estimand found unordered hypothesis-selection bounds but no embedding that preserves the exact-uniform Hölder CATE class and scalar target ordering.
seed_details.red_team: A finite-program counterexample at one sieve dimension cannot establish a full-class logarithmic lower radius.
seed_details.rebuttal: The seed requires a uniform growing-dimension embedding and is retained as the early kill alternative, not as a claim from one numerical instance.

proposed_from.literature_map: For the selected frontier, Kennedy et al. (2024) fix the nonprivate Hölder target and supply the fuzzy-hypothesis and higher-order local-polynomial geometry; Kennedy (2023) supplies the nuisance-product oracle structure. Asi et al. (2024) are the closest estimator ancestor, with clipped scores, Hamming sensitivity, and the exact finite-cover logarithmic step to replace. Birgé (2006), Canonne et al. (2019), Geng and Viswanath (2016), and Bun et al. (2021) delimit the test, scalar-shell, and generic-selection boundaries. Acharya et al. (2021) supplies the matching private converse technology. Niu et al. (2022), Schröder et al. (2025), and Asi, Duchi, and Talwar (2025) confirm that neither private CATE algorithms nor parametric single-coordinate certificates subsume the kernel. The exact target-method pair, log-free pure-private target-fiber estimation on the unchanged pointwise Hölder-CATE class with symbolic nonprivate risk, was not occupied in the checked threads.

banked_reason: The proposed log-free full-class pure-DP frontier is not delivered: the nuisance-independent full-fiber score construction, dense occupancy, and matched full-class estimator remain open; the sound contribution is an incremental sparse signed-family pair test.
banked_proposal_promise_gap: No full-class stable composite score, nuisance-entropy cancellation, dense-occupancy construction, total pure-DP estimator, or two-sided R_DP equivalence was proved.
